verdict.line: You lose if you stand and trade autos into Mundo's Q poke before level 3; you win if you E-pull him the instant Apprehend comes online and commit to the all-in.

brief.thesis: Darius holds the lane advantage and the solo-kill advantage here, but the 44.4% head-to-head win rate over 349 games tells the real story: Mundo's Adrenaline Rush sustain and Sadism let him survive your early windows and scale back into relevance. This is a lane you're supposed to win on paper and have to close out before his kit catches up.

theirWindow.what: Mundo throws Infected Cleaver (4s cooldown, 975 range, scales off your max health) for free since you have no gap-closer yet. Hug minions and walk up in short bursts instead of standing at max auto-attack range soaking it.

yourWindow.when: his Q just missed or is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Apprehend (E) is live the second it's off cooldown — close the gap, pull him in, and start stacking Hemorrhage with Q and autos before he can reset the fight.

start.why: Runs 43.8% over 331 games at a 77.9% pick rate — the extra sustain and early trade damage matter because you need to win exchanges outright before his Adrenaline Rush ticks the health back.

boots.why: Posts the better win rate of the two options (47% over 134 games) — Mundo's pressure comes from autos and Q poke stacking up over the laning phase, and flat damage reduction blunts that better than tenacity here.

core.why: The active haste gives you a second gap-close on top of E, which matters against a champion whose only real counter-engage is burning his own health to run.
The movespeed stacking lets you actually stay on top of him once Apprehend lands instead of letting him walk back to minion range and poke again.
This path hits 57.7% over 26 games — the damage-over-time conversion keeps you alive through his sustained mid-game trades while your own bleed stacks do the real work.

situational.when: their team adds hard CC that could lock you out of finishing the guillotine execute
mundo's team skews toward magic damage and you need the move speed to keep sticking him
you need another active slow to stop him from disengaging into a Sadism reset

runes.keystoneWhy: The higher-sample page (47.9% WR, 32% pick) runs Conqueror, and the stacking healing matters directly against a lane where he's trying to out-sustain you — note that master-tier Darius players instead favor Stormraider's Surge (Sorcery) over 3,021 games, which suits a more mobile, poke-dodging playstyle rather than grinding out extended trades.

summoners.why: Flash+Ghost is the most-picked combo (69.7% pick, 44.8% WR) and the extra mobility is exactly what OP.GG's own matchup note calls for — closing distance before he can poke freely or disengage. Flash+Ignite (40.3% WR) trades that mobility for a guaranteed early kill if you're confident you can force a level 2-3 all-in.

playing.title: Close distance before trading
playing.detail: Infected Cleaver is a 975-range, 4-second-cooldown poke that scales off your max health. Walk up behind minions in short bursts rather than standing still at range eating free Q's.

playing.title: Save E for the engage
playing.detail: Apprehend's pull is your only way to force a fight on a champion with no hard displacement of his own — don't waste the cooldown (26 down to 16s at max rank) chasing minions.

playing.title: Stack bleed before swinging R
playing.detail: Hemorrhage stacks up to 5 and enrages you with bonus AD at max stacks, and Noxian Guillotine's true damage scales with those stacks. Land Q and autos to full stacks before committing the ultimate instead of guillotining early.

playing.title: Respect Masochism at low Mundo HP
playing.detail: Masochism gives him bonus attack damage based on missing health, so a low-HP Mundo is not a safe Mundo to facetank. Finish him with a fully-stacked guillotine rather than trading autos at the end.

playing.title: Commit fully once hooked
playing.detail: Adrenaline Rush regenerates a chunk of his max health every second, so poke-and-retreat trades just heal back. Once E lands, go all the way through the fight instead of disengaging.

playing.title: Use W to lock him in range
playing.detail: Crippling Strike's empowered next attack slows him via the bleed on a 5-second cooldown. Chain it right after your E pull so he can't walk back out to Q range.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoner spells and all win-rate/sample figures above are measured OP.GG data from the current patch; the tactical reasoning — why the numbers shake out this way — is my own read of the matchup.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being punished by Dr. Mundo’s [Q] pokes. Try to close in before fighting him to kill him or at least get a Summoner’s Spell.
